artisanStory.name: Rameshwar Kumbhar
artisanStory.story: For over three generations, Rameshwar's family has turned alluvial riverbank clay into intricate terracotta sculptures. With ARTKALA's smart cataloging, his traditional pottery now reaches interior designers and conscious collectors without middlemen.
artisanStory.quote: Our hands shape what our ancestors dreamed. Every urn holds the smell of Indian soil.
